finalText:
All objectives complete. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Ticket `fwrd73-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (RD-1015, customer "Bench Customer"), initially in status Draft.

**2. DONE** — Part `fwrd73-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100, markup 25, qty 1. App-computed price: **$125.00** (parts total $125.00).

**3. DONE** — Part `fwrd73-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200, markup 25, qty 1. App-computed price: **$250.00** (parts total $375.00).

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup still 25). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (parts total $437.50).

**5. DONE** — Status set to **Ready**. The app's precondition, reported in an error alert reading exactly "Ticket is not ready" listing `Part "fwrd73-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier` and `Part "fwrd73-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier`, was that **every part must have a supplier**. What was required to satisfy it: editing each part and filling its Supplier field (set to "Bench Supplier" on both parts, previously "No supplier"). After that, the "Mark Ready" click was accepted with no error and the status line read "Ready" (controls changed to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed"). No toast/confirmation text was shown — the status line change was the confirmation.

**6. DONE** — Both parts deleted (each via a Confirm modal with a "Delete part" button; rows disappeared one at a time). The parts table is empty, showing the exact empty-state text "No parts on this ticket yet." with no total row. Ticket then archived: detail page shows an "Archived" badge and an "Unarchive ticket" button; the tickets list (Show archived unchecked) no longer shows RD-1015, and with Show archived checked it reads "RD-1015 | fwrd73-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-17". Nothing from this run remains active.
